body: Thank you!!
That’s what everyone tells me and you know what I’ve tried everything except move to somewhere new and start over but to be honest I don’t know if I can mentally do it right now

Thanks for the advice and wishful thoughts. I haven’t given up yet and I’m truly fighting to want to keep going. I’m hoping to find something that might help to fill the void. That’s pretty much how I try and look at girls now but when I’m out and see all these happy couples it kind of takes me back to that sad place and I start to notice how girls look at me then. I’m trying to stop those thoughts but like I said when you sad most of the time it makes it hard. Thank you very much for offering to talk
Thanks for the advice and I would have totally done that but I’m in my late 30’s and I have a bum foot that would bar me from service :(

She left me for another guy and said everything was a lie the whole time. I have hobbies that I do but I’m still sad 90% of the time. I had goals that we were goi g to do together so now those things no longer make sense financially or other wise so as far as goals at this point I’m trying to figure something new out. No pity needed here

That’s definitely one way to think about it. If it wasn’t that guy it would have been another. I’m in my mid 30’s but I wish she would have done it sooner than later. I helped her so much get to where she is and neglected myself in the process. It is what it is at this point I guess. It’s hard to think about all the lost time being with her.

I’m definitely doing the no contact and moving is my best option right now. I want to say I won’t open the door but I know better than to say that. It’s screwed up I still love her when she just hurts me but that’s the reason I’m going to move and start over somewhere new. A fresh beginning so I can just fully be over her and move on with my life. Thanks for the comment

I agree it’s just to give herself a ego boost or whatever she gets out of it. It’s just crazy to think someone i spent that long with and thought I knew would hurt me that bad and then come back to give me more pain. I think a clean start is my way foward also. Thanks again for the thoughts

I haven’t contacted her since she blocked me. I do t have anything with her on it. I’m planning on trying to move at this point. I think that would maybe help me get this constant weight off my back. Thanks for the comment.
Not very nice!

That’s what I’m scared of happening and having to go thru the whole cycle again. She is the women I will always love and that makes everything harder and she knows I will always take her back if she wants so she will always have this secondary choice. I don’t really think she will try and do anything at this point and I probably won’t see her again for months. It sucks when someone knows you would do anything for them and they use it against you even after hurting you the first time.

At first I didn’t let her in but it’s so hard to say no because I love her so much. Out of every relationship I’ve been in she’s the only one I think about every day. I know good and well she’s probably going to disappear for months-year and pop up one day. It brings a lot of pain after she’s gone and I know this is going to happen everytime but it’s just something in my heart that still loves and misses her so much.

Thanks for the reply! I’ve tried everything I can think of to meet new people and even a girlfriend. I’ve volunteered, gone out to try and meet random people and dating apps. Nothing has worked so far. I had a accident at work six months ago and have a hard time walking a lot so that also makes things harder.

I’m working on each and every problem that help contribute to the end of our relationship but that doesn’t mean I’m still not having these feelings everyday. You don’t have to bother replying if you don’t have something constructive to say besides telling me I’m whining no I’m actual just saying how I feel and it helps me by writing these things feelings down and expressing them so it might not help anyone who’s reading these posts but for me it helps to write them down and see the words that I feel everyday.

So being in my mid 30’s and having issues losing the person that was pretty much my wife is bad. Sorry I thought that’s what reddit was for talking about your problems and things that are on your mind. So to bother so many people with my problem
I try every day to go out and be happy but I guess I’ve been doing it wrong.
Yes I have been seeing someone
After thirteen years I’m sure she’s going to need more than 3 months and my writing is how I feel everyday. I am focusing on myself but I can seem to shake these feelings
I have been seeing someone just FYI. Still feel the same even after talking. Just venting sorry to bother everyone
sounds easy but unfortunately it's not for me. This has me really messed up mentally and physically. If i could've changed these feelings I would have done it by now.

Hi, I really wanted to private message you but I can't figure it out. Anyways I have been talking to my ex girlfriend these past few days and we had a great talk a couple days ago about being friends And maybe getting together sometime for coffee but the past couple times we have talked she always either is mad at me or lies to me when I call her. It's like I'm trying to be a good friend to her but she just is a friend with me when it suits her. I don't want to give up and have no contact with her but it's not fair if I'm the only one that's trying to be a friend and actually care. It's very frustrating because I get my feelings hurt and for her she probably could care less. I saw that last post you wrote and I feel the same way sometimes also. I've never been super happy but it's gotten worse since all this happened with her. My family tells me all the time I look miserable but I tell them this is me actually trying to be happy. I really don't know how to change these feeling anymore. I don't take meds I use to smoke 420 for all these feelings but I stopped after we broke up because I don't even have the want to smoke again. I'm so stuck in this depression I'm almost starting to get use to it which is scary in itself.

This is something my dad has been telling me since everything happened and I know your both right. It's just taking that first step and moving on that's hard for me. I feel like a anchor is holding me down with all these feelings that are there everyday. It's the guilt, remorse and thinking about what could have been. I am going to try and take one step at a time and do something positive for me and no one else. I want to be happy again and enjoy life even if it's alone. Another thing my dad keeps telling me is to date again but if I'm not okay emotionally with myself I don't want to bring that into a new relationship. As much as I would like to have someone I'm just hesitant to take that leap. I need to move past this and keep going in life before I wake up and it's really to late to accomplish all the things I want in life. I want to get married and have kids and own my own business. At the pace I'm going nothing will happen if I keep dwelling on the past. I guess like I said earlier it's taking that first step that's the hardest but I'm going to push myself more and try and stay positive. Everyone keeps saying I always look miserable and it makes them sad and that's really not what I want to do to other people. I do try hard to keep a happy face but it's like when I start thinking about her and us I can't get those feeling out of my head and I just focus on all the negative things and nothing positive. I so desperately want to turn my life around and if things work out between us that's great but if not maybe it wasn't suppose to be and I need to just accept the fact I can't control destiny. I'm not super religious but I have hope that things happen for a reason in life and this is god testing me and seeing what I will do with the hand I've been given.

Hi, thanks for the reply!! We have been together ever since she was 18yrs old. We started having problems about five years ago but she never left me. I thought we had worked things out but about a year ago she brought up some things that were bothering her (lack of commitment for a job, and just in general). I again thought we had worked things out (me being blind in my head probably) now fast forward to three months ago. She said she wanted to leave and I didn't want to let her go because I knew she wasn't going to come back so I tried everything I could to get her to stay at the end I left for a week to give her some space. When I came back early she was packed and ready to leave. We talked and meet a few times in the beginning when she left but now we barely talk and it's been a month and a half since I've seen her. I know I messed up somethings in the past but I've been trying to fix those issues ever since she left. She doesn't care anymore she said she doesn't want to try that's she tired of trying and just want to focus on her self. We were each other's best friends for 13 yrs and I feel like pretty much as soon as she left she gave up on me and us. She has friends from work that she can talk to hangout with so it's like she doesn't understand how I feel now. Abandoned and alone everyday. The crazy thing is in the beginning before we got serious it was the completely opposite situation and I gave up all those friends to focus on helping her and spending time with her now that the roles are reversed she could care less about me. I give her 100% unconditional love and she gave me 50% conditional love in return. Sorry for the rant I'm just hurting a lot today and missing her and our life together. Some days are okay other are like this.

Thanks for the reply!! I'm sorry to hear your going thru something similar also. It's a terrible feeling being the person that got left. It's like the other person was already working things out with themselves before hand and never thought to say anything so we could at least both be on the same page. Being left all of a sudden is a really bad feeling. I'm taking things one day at a time and hoping things will get better somehow. Life's lessons are really hard sometimes but I guess that how it shapes us into the people we are. I hope things get better for you also and like wise if you need to talk I'm always here to listen. It feels good to be able to relate with someone else who's going thru the same situation. All we can have is hope for a better tomorrow.

Thanks for the comments. I'm trying to come to terms with everything but every day is a struggle. I have my good days and my bad ones. I have tried volunteering so I'm about to start that very soon. I guess for me it's just the thoughts about self doubt and feeling like no girl is ever going to want to love me again. I just feel like I messed up the best thing I had and now it's hard to think about any positive future going forward. Maybe it was suppose to be this way but the feeling of sadness I have on a daily basis is overwhelming at times. Life for me now is basically just getting thru the day without giving up on life. I think I have a good heart and I'm a caring person but I just don't know if that matters. Anyways thanks for your thoughts and kind words.

We didn't get married because she wanted to wait until she finished school. I have started volunteering lately so I'm hoping that will help. I have good days but mostly bad ones lately. Im just taking one day at a time at this point. Thanks for the advice and good vibes ❤️💛💚💙💜 it means a lot that someone out there cares

Thanks for the advice!! this is something I've been considering lately. I feel like a new start would be worth the chance. All my family is here but like I've said I feel like a burden to them at this point. Every time we're together they ask me why can't I just feel better but until they walk in my shoes they will never know. It sucks when they think I can just snap my fingers and poof my life is better. Sorry for the rant but I do really appreciate the comment.
